# CHO dependency

This folder contains the CHO implementation used in this pipeline.

This pipeline requires the CHO implementation described in:

[Cho et al. (2024).](https://elifesciences.org/articles/91605) Novel cyclic homogeneous oscillation detection method for high accuracy and specific characterization of neural dynamics.

Please obtain the CHO code directly from the original authors/source and
place the required files in this directory.

Expected files:
- CHO_v22.m

Please cite the original publication when using this pipeline.
